description: Switches the Windows IME from a solo press of a modifier key
notes: Quit altoggle from the tray before 'scoop update altoggle'. A running instance holds the executable open.
'Start with Windows' writes an HKCU Run entry pointing at this install, and the settings live in %APPDATA%\altoggle. Neither is removed by 'scoop uninstall', so untick it from the tray menu first.
